description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class for the I18NImportErrorAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup for database fixtures, and test methods for API endpoints such as 'getAll', along with unimplemented tests for create and delete operations.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorAPITest
